thread:
Ravi: Follow-up from yesterday's postmortem: propose a concise owner-handback + sprintlet flow so actions don't linger.
Maya: yes please. what are the key SLAs?
Ravi: proposal: ack within 48h, short mitigation in 5BD, sprintlet close by 14BD, permanent plan by 30d. owners must respond with ACCEPT/REASSIGN/DECLINE.
Tess: prefer 5 business days for mitigation, and require owner email in the action line so boards can parse.
Ravi: agreed. single-line action format: `ACTION | owner:Name;email | task:short-desc | SLA:5BD | ticket:#1234`
IC-bot: tip: include `sprintlet:true` and `handback:true` in the incident doc to enable the flow and auto-create a board card.
Maya: comms cadence suggestion: alert -> 1hr quick note -> 24hr summary -> 5BD checkpoint -> sprintlet close update. short bullets only.
OpsBot: I can nudge owners at 36h and again at 4BD if no ack. set `auto_reminders:true` flag.
Tess: metrics: owner-ack % at 48h, mitigation % at 5BD, sprintlet close rate at 14BD, repeat-incident count monthly.
Ravi: rollout plan: pilot for 6 weeks on P1/P2 incidents. Alex will own the dashboard and report biweekly.
Maya: I'll draft the PR for /docs/incidents with the timeline, owner format, IC-week rules, and bot flags. target EOD Wed.
Ravi: thanks. small win if we can raise ack rates and reduce dangling actions. closing thread; PR link to follow.
